name: Static imports introduce only explicitly requested names

input.fixture_ref: Compile a consumer with selective imports, indirect extensions and a later Package.load, then inspect its lexical namespace and static API.

applicability.reason: Requires import-scoped name visibility. Package sources now accept declarations and a probe observes them, and measuring shows the isolation this row asserts does NOT hold: a consumer importing only `Pub` still resolves `Hidden.secret()`, so every declared Module is globally visible.

expect.status: Only requested static names exist; no implicit re-export, indirect extension activation or retroactive runtime-loaded lexical name appears.
